verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a community marketplace, hub, or any way to install integrations contributed by people outside the vendor. Running any language or Docker image, and syncing scripts from Git, are developer building blocks rather than a community-contribution install path. A community comment calling the model 'open and extensible' is sentiment, not a documented capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install community-built nodes, components, or integrations contributed outside the vendor
